Class PresenceMatrix

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.model.PresenceMatrix
public class PresenceMatrix extends Object
A two-dimensional matrix of ASN presence across Equinix metros.

Rows represent target ASNs; columns represent Equinix metros. Each cell is a PresenceCell containing rich connectivity data (IX peering, Fabric availability, port capacity, route server participation). The matrix supports both ASN-centric views ("where is AWS present?") and metro-centric views ("who is present in DC?").

Output Formats

  • toTableString() — ASCII table for console output
  • toDetailedTableString() — ASCII table with capacity annotations
  • toMarkdown() — Markdown table for reports
